__doc__: Copy this entry, delete the __doc__ key, fill in your values. One object per site. Field reference at the bottom.
note: Free-text description of why this site is in the list — surfaces in reports.

__field_reference__.id: REQUIRED. Unique slug. Becomes the per-site profile filename (profiles/<id>__<viewport>.json).
__field_reference__.url: REQUIRED. The landing URL the agent navigates to first.
__field_reference__.credentials: Optional. { email, password } — used by sign_in flow. If omitted, sign_in uses test@example.com / Test1234! (will fail on real sites — set real test creds).
__field_reference__.query: Optional. Search term used by search_product / add_to_cart flows. Defaults to 'shirt'.
__field_reference__.flows: Optional. Array of flow keys (sign_in, search_product, add_to_cart, checkout, food_order, …) overriding the archetype-chosen plan. Leave null to let the classifier choose.
__field_reference__.viewports: Optional. Array of viewport configs. Each entry is either { name, viewport:{width,height} } OR { name?, device:'<Playwright device name>' }. If omitted, runs once at 1280x800 desktop. Device names: any string accepted by Playwright's devices map — 'iPhone 14', 'Pixel 7', 'iPad Pro 11', 'Galaxy S9+', 'Desktop Chrome HiDPI', etc.
__field_reference__.locale: Optional. Force a locale (e.g. 'es-MX'). If null, locale is auto-detected from <html lang>.
__field_reference__.versionUrl: Optional. URL returning a short version string. The poll-mode trigger (serve.sh) watches this and re-runs the site when it changes.
__field_reference__.note: Optional. Human-readable context — shows up in reports.

__usage__: 1. Save your sites as e.g. config/my-sites.json
2. Test the JSON parses:   jq . config/my-sites.json
5. Scheduled:              copy a line from cron.example
